# Test Plan — DEMO-001 (User Login Feature)

*Generated by `/create-test-plan DEMO-001`*

---

## Objective

Validate that the login flow correctly authenticates users, rejects invalid credentials, enforces rate limiting and account lockout, and handles session expiry — against the staging environment only.

## Scope

- Login form submission (happy path and negative cases)
- API-level credential validation
- Account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts
- Lockout expiry after 15 minutes
- Session expiry redirect with toast notification
- Cross-browser cookie behavior (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)

## Out of Scope

- Password reset flow (separate ticket)
- OAuth / social login (not implemented)
- Load testing (separate performance sprint)

## Environment Requirements

- **Test environment:** `https://staging.yourapp.com`
- **Production environment:** EXCLUDED — tests must never run against production

## Risk Areas (from codebase analysis)

| Risk | Severity | Coverage Priority |
|------|----------|-------------------|
| Account lockout logic (new, untested) | High | Must cover — full lockout + unlock cycle |
| Session expiry redirect race condition | Medium | Cover redirect; toast is best-effort |
| Safari cross-origin cookie | Medium | Include Safari in browser matrix |
| Generic error message consistency | Low | Verify via direct API test |

## Test Cases Summary

### Happy Path
- TC-001: Valid credentials → redirect to `/dashboard`
- TC-002: Verify auth cookie set as httpOnly after login
- TC-003: `/api/auth/me` returns correct user after login

### Negative / Error Cases
- TC-004: Wrong password → generic error message displayed
- TC-005: Non-existent email → same generic error (no account enumeration)
- TC-006: Empty email field → form validation error (client-side)
- TC-007: Empty password field → form validation error (client-side)
- TC-008: Malformed email format → form validation error

### Boundary / Rate Limiting
- TC-009: 4 failed attempts → no lockout yet, error still shows
- TC-010: 5th failed attempt → account locked message shown
- TC-011: API returns 423 on 6th attempt while locked
- TC-012: After 15-minute window, user can log in again

### Regression
- TC-013: Back button after login does not re-submit form
- TC-014: Session expiry after 30 min inactivity → redirect to `/login`
- TC-015: "Session expired" toast visible on redirect

### Cross-Browser
- TC-016: Safari — auth cookie set correctly (cross-origin scenario)

## Data Requirements

- Test user account (email + known password) — created via DataFactory
- Second test user for isolation testing
- Clock-manipulation capability (or patience) for lockout expiry test

## Estimated Test Count

16 test cases (13 automatable, 3 manual/time-dependent)
